## Lead drop count
Reads all lead rows from input.
Converts timestamps into a standard YYYY-MM-DD format.
Counts total leads for each day.
Calculates:
Today’s lead count
7-day rolling average
Lead drop percentage
Detects:
Lead drop alerts
Zero lead critical alerts
Generates:
Severity level (NORMAL, WARNING, HIGH, CRITICAL)
Channel-wise breakdown
Source-wise breakdown
Best-performing day in rolling window

=🚨 *CRITICAL Lead Volume Alert*

A severe drop in lead volume has been detected.

• Today's Leads:{{ $json.todayCount }} 
• 7-Day Avg: {{$json.rollingAvg}}
• Drop Percentage: {{$json.dropPercent}}%
• Severity: {{$json.severity}}

Possible causes:
• Ads stopped
• CRM/webhook failure
• Tracking issue
• Form submission failure
• Traffic outage

Best Recent Day:
• {{$json.bestDay}} → {{$json.bestCount}} leads

Immediate investigation recommended.
